description: An escape sequence that cancels nothing (section 7).

findings.message: `\U` cancels nothing, so the backslash and `U` both render. Write `\\U` to keep both on purpose.
`\d` cancels nothing, so the backslash and `d` both render. Write `\\d` to keep both on purpose.

cases.name: an escape in an option key

findings.message: `\x` cancels nothing, so the backslash and `x` both render. Write `\\x` to keep both on purpose.
